content:
I narrowed it down with some testing.

Very specifically, Mute Jukebox sees the TEMPORARY Singularity Beacon—the one given to a card as it's played and removed when it resolves—as a copiable value.

Since this special Beacon affix doesn't prevent a card from triggering Dimension Shuttle, the copies that now have Beacon (only by means of Jukebox) can get Beacon *again,* and can keep stacking it if they keep triggering Jukebox.

Mute Jukebox doesn't see the *real* Singularity Beacon as copiable (see video 4), only the *temporary* version of it.

Bonus note: I know this "temporary" Beacon isn't the *real* Singularity Beacon because Arachne's OverExalt can't find it! (See video 3 where only 1 Biomimicry was created)
